{{Top|leg}}
A '''spear gun''' was a projectile weapon designed for underwater use. The [[Sedrian]]s from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] used the weapon as their primary armament,<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref> and they were available on [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Spira/Legends|Spira]].<ref name="TSR">{{JournalCite|1|The Spira Regatta}}</ref> It was the weapon of choice for [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Deep Hunter]]s.<ref name="DU">''[[Death in the Undercity]]''</ref>
